meta.description: Expanding-window folds before the holdout. The spread of the improvement column is the noise level the holdout result has to clear.

sources.name: SPEC CPU 2017 published results
sources.licence: SPEC fair use rules: results may be cited with attribution to SPEC and the retrieval date, and estimates must be labelled as estimates.
sources.frequency: weekly collection; SPEC publishes new results about every two weeks
sources.typical_lag: results appear weeks to months after the test date

limitations: SPEC results are submitted by hardware vendors and are dominated by servers.
Each result is one tested configuration: memory, compiler and operating system differ between results for the same processor.
Scores are SPECrate 2017 Integer base. No other suite or metric is mixed in.
